plugins.name: aio-gherkin-refine
plugins.description: Refines ambiguous user requests into structured Gherkin format (Given/When/Then) before implementation.

plugins.name: aio-claude-manager
plugins.description: Enable/disable skills based on project context. Reduce skill clutter for specific project types.

plugins.name: aio-neobrutalism
plugins.description: Apply neobrutalism design patterns to web UI. Bold borders, hard shadows, vibrant colors.

plugins.name: aio-bun-fullstack-setup
plugins.description: Setup Bun server serving both API and static frontend on single port with Vite proxy in dev.

plugins.name: aio-mental-models
plugins.description: Comprehensive mental models framework from The Great Mental Models series. 50+ models for decision-making, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.

plugins.name: aio-reflect
plugins.description: Learn from Claude Code sessions to extract reusable knowledge. Analyzes corrections, preferences, and technical discoveries to build CLAUDE.md rules and new skills.

plugins.name: aio-monitoring-observability
plugins.description: Monitoring and observability strategy, implementation, and troubleshooting. Metrics design (Golden Signals, RED/USE), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), alerting, SLOs, dashboards, log aggregation, and tool selection. Includes 7 automation scripts and production-ready templates.

plugins.name: aio-ios-device-debug
plugins.description: Debug iOS apps on physical devices. Build, install, launch, capture logs, pull crash reports, and analyze crashes from the terminal.

plugins.name: aio-codebase-oracle
plugins.description: Comprehensive codebase analysis and documentation: CodeIndex static analysis (dependency graphs, codebase maps, metrics, community detection) combined with Oracle direct documentation writing. Optionally collaborates with CocoIndex for semantic search. Produces architecture docs (C4 diagrams, dependency graphs, key flows), module docs, and interactive HTML viewers.

plugins.name: aio-grafana-diagram
plugins.description: Guide for using grafana-diagram plugin to create Mermaid diagrams with data binding in Grafana dashboards. Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, gantt charts, state diagrams with dynamic metric-driven coloring.

plugins.name: aio-jira
plugins.description: Jira operations through MCP tools. Issue management, sprint tracking, workflow transitions, comments, JQL search, and development information. Auto-installs jira-mcp server if missing.

plugins.name: aio-react-minimal-effects
plugins.description: Minimize useEffect in React 19. Covers React Compiler, new hooks (useActionState, useOptimistic), ref as prop, and proper patterns.

plugins.name: aio-mermaid
plugins.description: Generate shareable MinimalMermaid diagram URLs. Compress mermaid code into shareable links.

plugins.name: aio-code-review
plugins.description: Ultimate code review with multi-phase pipeline: domain-specific skill detection (Go, iOS, React, XState, observability), CodeWiki static analytics, 4 core + 4 conditional parallel review agents, and a critic meta-review that eliminates false positives and provides confidence scoring.

plugins.name: aio-xstate
plugins.description: XState v5 strict ruleset for TypeScript state machines. setup().createMachine() patterns, design-first planning, params-first typing, anti-god-machine enforcement, actor patterns (fromPromise, fromCallback, fromObservable, fromTransition), invoke vs spawnChild, and React integration.

plugins.name: aio-debug
plugins.description: Systematic debug & fix orchestrator. Four-phase pipeline: codebase context → root cause investigation → minimal fix → code review validation.

plugins.name: aio-golang-mastery
plugins.description: Complete Go development skill covering idiomatic patterns, error handling, concurrency, interfaces, generics, testing (TDD, fuzzing, benchmarks), project structure, production hardening, and gRPC. Based on Google Go Style Guide, Uber Go Style Guide, and Effective Go. Updated for Go 1.25.

plugins.name: aio-cocoindex
plugins.description: CocoIndex-based semantic search with Qdrant vector storage, auto language detection and tree-sitter code chunking. One project = one unified index. Zero-config: just set PROJECT_NAME and SOURCE_DIRS. Two skills: aio-cocoindex-setup (scaffold .cocoindex/) and aio-cocoindex (search and maintain).

plugins.name: aio-feedback
plugins.description: Submit feedback, bug reports, feature requests, and plugin requests for aiocean plugins directly from Claude Code via GitHub Issues.
